# Replica Entrepreneur, find what users hate and make your clone better than the original

Curated by Skill Harbor: the reason-to-exist step of the 11-skill Replica pack. A straight copy has no reason to exist, so Replica Entrepreneur reads what the original's real users say in public reviews across at least three sources, ranks what they hate, what is missing and what is unsolved, and turns the strongest evidence into a fix plan and a positioning angle. Every quote is real, verbatim and linked, themes with too little evidence are marked thin, and nothing is fabricated: if there are 14 reviews, it says 14. Reviewers' words are research, never testimonials. By @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Skill Harbor never reviews the code of a listed skill, so review it yourself before use.
